acceptance_review: Current compliance workflow fixtures_self_test lacks generic-admission, standalone-admission, start_path and new durable-resume regression commands. Adding four exact deterministic commands protects actual source fixes.

Scope explicitly adds protected .github/workflows/compliance.yml. Existing job/runner/permissions/required-check names/protections stay unchanged; no assertions/test implementation changes authorized.

Existing pinned setup Python/CI requirements and checkout provide current authored tools; no paid/live provider calls introduced. Remote exact-head CI remains final execution proof, not inferred from this proposal.
limitations: Bounded source amendment approval only; actual candidate and required runtime/CI checks remain independently reviewed.
Fresh context does not establish physical lineage or enforced OS sandbox.
